items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: And I got Baby Dots on drums, Pep Wallace on bass, Rob Smith on guitar, Roy Palmer on trombone, myself on conant... Seven pieces.

ctx.x: What was your first instrument? Did you start on the cornet?

Well, no, I didn't. I started on the cornet, but I put it down. I started to play bass. That was a one-string bass. I had one bass made out of a soapbox. We had an original guitar and an original mandolin. Rob Smith was the guitar player's name. And the mandolin player, I forget his name, but I made me a bass out of one string, out of a cat gut, one string. It went so good until I changed from the soapbox and got a bass with one string on it. And we played that for a while. Well, that didn't last long because in…
